# freecenter_networks (Data Source)

Networking of a FreeCenter host (by host_id or host_name): the networks virtual machines can connect to, and the standard virtual switches and port groups behind them.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host_id` (String)
- `host_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `networks` (List of String) Names of the networks available to virtual machines.
- `port_groups` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--port_groups))
- `vswitches` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vswitches))

<a id="nestedatt--port_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `port_groups`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String)
- `vlan` (Number)
- `vswitch` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--vswitches"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vswitches`

Read-Only:

- `mtu` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `uplinks` (List of String)
